rows.text: NCLT Mumbai sanctions the Scheme of Amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary News18 Marathi into the Company, effective once all conditions precedent are fulfilled (verified before the 14:22 freeze; carries through unchanged).
NCLT Delhi directs creditor/shareholder meetings on its previously-disclosed scheme to merge subsidiary Cyber Media Research & Services into itself (First Motion order, no new terms).
received a Chennai sales-tax assessment order for FY 2001-02 demanding **Rs 97.16 lakh**; it calls the order contrary to settled law and plans a writ petition.
discloses an **order passed by the Commercial Taxes Department, Chennai**. The figures sit in the annexure beyond the cached pages, so none is quoted.
